name: bloodpet
description: a Bloodpet, a gaunt frenzied Calabim thrall: pale skin, wild shaggy dark-brown hair, a red-pupilled eye and a gaping bloody mouth, a bare chest with a dark choker and a red sash across it, a ragged black loincloth with a red waist cloth, dark leg wraps with red bands and dark boots; a wooden club studded with bone-coloured knobs raised high in his RIGHT hand and a round red-and-black wooden shield with steel studs and a steel rim on his LEFT arm
hands: the knobbed club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the round shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the knobbed club is lifted up over the head with its heavy end pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the club cocked behind the head with its knobbed end hanging down behind the shoulders, the round shield tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-left, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the club is level, its knobbed end pointing to the lower-left
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the knobbed club smashing down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the shield arm swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its knobbed end nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, shaggy hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the club lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the round shield flung out to the right, club arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the club dipping, the round shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the round shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's knobbed end resting on the ground, the shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right; the club lies on the ground at the lower-left; the round shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the club and the round shield on the ground beside him
